blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.
blocks.zh: 我们提出SNO-PI,这是截至2026年10月18日SNOMED国际SNOMED的SNOMED CT实体链接基准上表现最出色的呈文. SNO-PI实现宏字符IoU为0.5387,表现优于组织者的参考系统(0.4582;基于2024挑战胜者方法),相对比为18%. 将临床与SNOMED CT联系起来是一个零射出和几射出的问题,因为一个非常大的标签空间:272个附加说明的MIMIC-IV放出摘要只涉及大约219 000个合格概念中的6 595个,其中三分之一只发生一次。 这激发了一种基于从经过预先培训的模型和人性化知识转移而来的设计. SNO-PI将高召跨建议,SapBERT候选取用和列表组合重排与3个BERT-家族编码器,在任务微调前在未加标签的MIMIC-IV音符上再用蒙面语言建模进行进一步预训并再进行SNOMED CT同义词和分级. 我们认为,掌握的知识对培训中从未见过的概念最有帮助,但这些概念仍然是出错的主要原因。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Much of what clinicians record about a patient lives only in free text. A discharge summary carries diagnoses,
examination findings, procedures and allergies in the shorthand of clinical practice: “hct”, “SOBOE”,
“lap chole”. Until these are linked to a reference terminology such as SNOMED CT, they are invisible to allergy alerts,
problem lists, registries and research queries. Unlike general-domain entity linking, clinical linking cannot rely on large labelled corpora: shareable clinical notes are
scarce because they contain protected health information, and labelling them requires clinical expertise, which
is costly and slow to obtain. The 2024 SNOMED CT Entity Linking
Challenge [ 1 ] released a public corpus [ 2 ] of discharge notes densely annotated with
SNOMED CT [ 3 ] , drawn from MIMIC-IV-Note [ 4 , 5 ] .
Its organisers concluded that data, rather than model architecture, limited performance, with rare and unseen
concepts the hardest [ 1 ] . SNOMED International continues it as an open benchmark [ 6 ] , hosted by
DrivenData and scored on a hidden set of about 20 notes.

blocks.en:
The scale of the gap is stark. The 272 annotated notes contain about 75,000 labels, but they touch only 6,595 of the
roughly 219,000 concepts eligible for linking [ 2 ] , or about 3%. Any test note will therefore mention concepts for which no
labelled example exists. Yet the domain is unusually rich in curated knowledge: SNOMED CT itself supplies
synonyms, fully specified names and an is-a hierarchy for every concept, the UMLS [ 7 ] links
these to millions of further names, and hundreds of thousands of unlabelled clinical notes are available for
self-supervision.

大约21.9万个概念有资格连接[2],或约3%. 因此,任何试验说明将提及没有
标签示例存在。 然而这个领域却异常丰富,
同义词, 完全指定的名称和每个概念的等级, UMLS [ 7] 链接
还有数十万无标签的临床笔记

blocks.en:
The 272 notes hold 75,463 spans over 6,595 distinct concepts. The
distribution is long-tailed: 2,504 concepts occur once and 4,788 five times or fewer. Figure 1 shows how slowly coverage grows with annotation effort. With 174 training notes, only 77% of the concepts in a
random 20-note test sample have been seen at least once, and the curve extrapolates to only about 84% at all 272
notes. Because the metric is macro-averaged, these unseen concepts (about 20% of the concepts in a sample, but only
9% of spans) weigh far more than their frequency.

blocks.en:
Six clinicians annotated the corpus, mostly one per note, with mean
pairwise Jaccard agreement of 0.85, which the organisers treat as an upper bound on achievable IoU [ 1 ] .
Within the remaining disagreement, peripheral choices vary between notes. In Figure 2 , only one of
several listed allergies is annotated; clinically, this does not mean the patient tolerates the other drugs, but
reflects selective annotation, which matters when judging model errors against this reference. Such choices are
consistent within a note, plausibly reflecting individual annotators’ habits: pcp is annotated at every
occurrence in 32 notes and at none in 38, and the same phrase elsewhere in the note predicts annotation better than
the phrase alone (83.5% vs 70.9%). Hand-written normalisation rules all lowered our score, whereas learned
rerankers absorbed these conventions implicitly through the none option and alias statistics.

blocks.en:
We held out the 68 notes of the original 2024 test split plus 30 training notes
(dev) and trained on the remaining 174. Every score is the mean over 1,000 random 20-note subsets (sd about 0.014),
and a change was accepted only if it gained more than 0.003 on both dev and test on paired subsets. Final submissions were retrained on all 272 public notes. Models were
trained on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-series GPUs.

blocks.en:
Exact matches of in-scope SNOMED CT terms are united with the spans of a
BERT-CRF [ 8 , 9 ] tagger and with all span texts seen in training. The union reaches 94–95% exact and 99% overlap
recall of gold spans. Candidates are retrieved with SapBERT [ 10 ] , a PubMedBERT [ 11 ] encoder trained on UMLS synonym sets, over an index of all in-scope SNOMED descriptions plus 12.7k training aliases.
Because the index is built from curated synonyms rather than from labels, it reaches concepts no annotator has used:
recall@10 is 0.97 overall and 0.77 on concepts unseen in training.

由于索引是用拼音同义词而不是用标签构建的,因此它达到了没有注释者使用的概念:
召回@10为总0.97,在培训中未见的概念方面为0.77。

blocks.en:
The rerankers start from encoders that already carry broad
language knowledge and, for two of the three, biomedical knowledge: Bio_ClinicalBERT [ 12 ] was
trained on PubMed abstracts and MIMIC-III notes, BioLinkBERT-large [ 15 ] on PubMed with
citation links, and ModernBERT-large [ 16 ] on a large general corpus including scientific
text. The staged recipe builds on this prior rather than replacing it. The clearest evidence is
Table 2 : after SNOMED pre-training alone, with no annotated notes, the encoder already picks the right
concept for 85% of seen and 71% of unseen gold spans. Biomedical pre-training matters most where labels are absent: in a controlled comparison of base-size encoders
under one early recipe, BioLinkBERT had the highest unseen-concept accuracy (.784, against .763 to .778 for the
others), and a general-domain encoder with a weaker adaptation (DeBERTa-v3 [ 17 ] ) was clearly
worse (.451 vs .487 macro). The three encoders were also chosen for diverse pre-training:
any two different encoders combined gain +.010 to .015 macro, while two Bio_ClinicalBERT variants gain nothing.

The tagger and all three reranker encoders were further pre-trained with masked
language modelling [ 8 ] on 50,000 unlabelled MIMIC-IV discharge summaries (166M tokens;
held-out perplexity 13.94 → \rightarrow 2.86 for Bio_ClinicalBERT [ 12 ] ), a form of domain-adaptive
pre-training [ 13 ] that adapts them to the
abbreviations, list structure and line-wrapped layout of discharge notes. In our experiments it improved both downstream tasks, span tagging and
reranking, consistently on dev and test.

重新排队, 坚持在德夫和测试。

blocks.en:
Before seeing any annotated note, each reranker is
trained on SNOMED CT itself: a synonym of a concept acts as the query, and the model must pick the right concept from
fully specified names, synonyms and parents among SapBERT-retrieved options, with the concept’s parent and most
similar siblings added as hard negatives. This stage teaches the model the
terminology’s structure across concepts that the 272 notes never mention, following the idea of enhancing
cross-encoders with knowledge-graph hierarchy for zero- and few-shot medical entity linking [ 14 ] . Table 2 shows the C-DAPT reranker after each
training stage. A separate ablation put the stage’s gain after fine-tuning at +0.015 macro, almost all on unseen concepts.

only probability on wrong concepts, so the model learns to abstain conservatively rather than link a wrong concept. Each option is

score all options in a single forward pass via a linear head on its hidden states, without text generation. Tested in
isolation, it is the strongest single member, and in the ensemble it gave a small improvement on the hidden test set
(0.5352 → \rightarrow 0.5387 macro).

(±\pm 1 句子在它的节首路径下,加上最多三个相互竞争的重叠跨度, 也是候选人:.). 在大背景中竞争的跨度获得了+0.018 dev /+0.013测试宏. 最后呈件增加了第七个成员:Qune3-8B [18],Lora-tuned [19] to
在所有选项中通过隐藏状态的线性头通过单个前传来得分,而不产生文本。 已测试
这是最强的单一成员 在综艺节目中 它对隐藏的测试集做了一点改进
(0.5352~\右旋0.5387宏).

blocks.en:
Training candidates are built with 5-fold cross-fitted aliases and
dictionaries, so that about 20% of training mentions look unseen, as they will at test time.
blocks.zh:
培训对象采用5倍跨型别名和
字典,这样大约20%的训练 提到看不见,在测试的时候。

blocks.en: Member probabilities are averaged; a span is linked if its top concept beats none with p ≥ 0.5 p\geq 0.5 , and overlaps are resolved greedily by confidence.
blocks.zh: 成员概率是平均的;如果最高概念比无高0.5 p\geq 0.5 p\geq 0.5 p\geq 0.5,而重叠问题则由信心贪婪地解决,则跨度是联系在一起的。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: SNO-PI ranks first on the benchmark on both metrics (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: SNO-PI在两个衡量标准的基准上排名第一(表3)。

blocks.zh: 表3:2026年10月18日公共基准领先板.

Its macro score is 0.040 above the next-best entry and 0.081 (18% relative) above the organisers’ reference
Super Dictionary solution, which follows the approach of the 2024 winner, KIRIs [ 20 ] . Table 4 traces the system’s development; local estimates tracked the official scores.

它的宏分数是 0.040 次最佳条目和 0.081 (相对) 次优组织者的参考文献

blocks.en:
Curated knowledge narrows the gap but does not close it.
Table 5 replaces each stage with an oracle: a perfect reranker over our existing candidates would add
about 0.30 macro, against 0.06 for perfect retrieval and 0.12 for perfect spans. Concepts with 0–2 training examples
make up 36% of concepts but 58% of the remaining gap, and the share of gold concepts we predict at all rises
steeply with their first few labelled examples (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh:
被诅咒的知识缩小了差距,但并没有弥补差距。
表5用甲骨文取代每个阶段:比现有候选人更完美的排名将增加
约0.30宏,对0.06 完美检索和0.12 完美跨度。 0至2个培训实例的概念
占概念的36%,但占剩余差距的58%,我们预测的黄金概念所占的份额会上升
与第一批被标注的例子相对立(图4)。

培训实例的数目(早期的三编码系统,当地测试,300个随机20个注样本)。

blocks.en:
Unseen concepts mostly fail before the reranker (no span or not retrieved),
while rare-but-seen concepts fail inside it. Even a small increase in labels pays: aliases from 204 instead of
174 notes, with rerankers unchanged, added +0.004 test macro.
blocks.zh:
不明概念大多在重排前失败(无跨度或未检索),
而稀有但可见的概念却在其中失败. 甚至小幅增加标签支付:别名从204而不是
174个注,重新排行榜不变,增加了+0.004测试宏.

blocks.en: Table 5: Stage-wise analysis of the six-member system (174 training notes), with oracles applied cumulatively.
blocks.zh: 表5:对六人制的分阶段分析(174个培训说明),并累计适用甲骨文.

blocks.en: 5 When more knowledge did not help
blocks.zh: 页:1 当更多的知识没有帮助

blocks.en:
Several attempts to inject further curated or pre-trained knowledge improved single models or intermediate metrics
but not the final ensemble (Table 6 ). A recurring pattern is that gains outside SNOMED, or in recall
alone, do not transfer to the linking decision. The hierarchy near misses in Table 6 also show a limit of
exact-match scoring: predicting Renal calculus for gold Staghorn calculus scores zero, the same
as an unrelated diagnosis, although the two are clinically close. A hierarchy-aware metric would reflect clinical
usefulness better.
blocks.zh:
几次尝试注入经过进一步整理或预先培训的知识,改进了单一模型或中间计量标准
但不是最后的综艺节目(表6). 经常出现的情况是,在SNOMED之外,或召回
仅此而已,不转至关联决定。 表6中接近错失的等级也显示一个限度:
准确的比分:预测金子的雷纳尔微积分 斯塔格霍恩微积分的分数为零,相同
虽然两者在临床上是接近的 分级认识的衡量标准将反映临床
更有用处

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en:
The system used the AU 2025-08-31 release of SNOMED CT, as the prescribed November 2025 International release could
not be obtained; 100 training concepts are inactive in it. With about 20 hidden notes, differences of a few
thousandths of macro IoU are within noise. Some error stems from note-level annotation
conventions unresolvable from the text.
blocks.zh:
该系统使用AU 2025-08-31发布SNOMED CT,因为规定的2025年11月国际发布可以
无法获取;100个培训概念在其中不活跃。 大约20个隐藏的音符, 少数差异
千分之十的大型IoU在噪音中。 一些错误源于注级注释
公约无法从案文中解决。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
With labels for approximately 3% of eligible concepts, SNOMED CT entity linking is a low-resource problem inside a
knowledge-rich domain. SNO-PI leads the benchmark by drawing on unlabelled clinical text, the curated synonyms and
structure of SNOMED CT, and large pre-trained models at every stage, and this knowledge is most valuable precisely
where labels are absent. The steep gains from each additional labelled example, however, suggest that targeted
annotation of rare concepts remains the most effective next step.
blocks.zh:
将 SNOMED CT 实体连接起来,
知识丰富的领域。 SNO-PI通过使用未加标签的临床文本、所描述的同义词和
SNOMED CT的结构,以及每个阶段的大型预先训练的模型,这种知识非常宝贵。
没有标签。 然而,从每个附加标注的例子中获得的显著收益表明,
对稀有概念的注释仍然是最有效的下一步。
